name: Dissident-class light cruiser
description: The Dissident-class light cruiser was a type of warship that served in the First Order Navy by around 31 ABY. In that year, New Republic Commander Poe Dameron encountered a number of First Order starships at a staging point in the OR-Kappa-2722 system, which included a Dissident-class cruiser. Dameron then briefly engaged several First Order TIE fighters before fleeing the system.
